Subject: [Perl Jobs] Perl/Mason Web Developer (onsite), United States, NY, New York

Online URL for this job: http://jobs.perl.org/job/7420

To subscribe to this list, send mail to jobs-subscribe@perl.org.
To unsubscribe, send mail to jobs-unsubscribe@perl.org.

Posted: February 15, 2008

Job title: Perl/Mason Web Developer

Company name: Shutterstock

Location: United States, NY, New York

Pay rate: DOE

Travel: 0%

Terms of employment: Salaried employee

Hours: Full time

Onsite: yes

Description:
Shutterstock.com is looking for a Perl/Mason web developer to join our tech
team. We're a small, fun, and casual company with a startup culture. We're
looking for experienced Perl programmers who can get complicated projects
done efficiently. You should have a keen interest in and enthusiasm for
high-traffic web sites and all the excitement they offer: optimization,
load balancing, redundancy, failover, tiered architectures, etc. Applicants
must be local to the New York area and able to work in the U.S.

Required skills:
At least 5 years experience with:

* Perl
* HTML / CSS / Javascript
* MySQL
* Linux

Desired skills:
* HTML::Mason
* AJAX
* layout / design
* ImageMagick (and PerlMagick)
* other languages (php, bash, C, etc.)
* mod_perl / Apache
* video editing
* network filesystems
* MySQL replication and optimization

URL for more information: http://www.shutterstock.com/jobs.mhtml

Contact information at:
http://jobs.perl.org/job/7420#contact
